reconciliation_policy: Attach appearances only to existing modern Berlin records carrying the same exact VA inventory number. Publication object keys are added only for the five bowls actually edited, not for incidental cross-references. No identity merge or preferred reading is inferred.
text_policy: The underlying German translations are public domain, but they are not imported from OCR in this batch. Public text requires separate page-by-page transcription, proofreading, and a content-bound publication decision.
